n95f4d3317c.summary: Rotermann City, part of Urmas Sõõrumaa's business group, recorded a nearly sevenfold increase in turnover last year.
n95f4d3317c.why: Significant growth in real estate turnover indicates strong market demand and investment activity in Estonia's property sector.
